Inside was a single sheet of waxed paper, the ink still crisp: coordinates, a name—her daughter's name—and the words 'I am safe, waiting at this place.' Her daughter had been lost at sea four years prior. Maren read the note three times, pocketed it against her chest, locked the lantern room, and walked to the harbor to find a boat willing to take her north.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睡着。路灯将橘黄色的光晕投在空荡荡的街道上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，车轮碾过积水，溅起短暂的声响。便利店的玻璃门后，收银员趴在柜台上打盹，荧光灯白得刺眼。远处的立交桥上，一列货车缓缓爬行，车灯像两只倦怠的眼睛。小区门口的保安裹紧了军大衣，呵出一口白雾。连流浪猫也找到了藏身的角落，不再走动。整座城市悬在夜与晨之间，像一个被搁置的念头，沉默、疲倦，却依然亮着。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by breaking it into a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you need to look up.\n• Every time it solves a smaller version, it repeats the same steps on that smaller version, and then again on an even smaller one, until the problem is so tiny it has an obvious answer.\n• Once it reaches that tiny obvious answer, it works its way back through all the steps it stacked up, like unstacking a pile of plates one by one, until the whole original problem is solved."}
